Name: Serah
Summary: Serah was the daughter of Asher and the sister of Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui, and Beriah.
KeyStory: Serah is the only daughter of Jacob's sons named in the list of those who went into Egypt.
RelatedPeople: Asher; Jimnah; Ishuah; Isui; Beriah; Heber; Malchiel
LifeLesson: God names women in genealogies where the world might forget them.
